content.thinking:
I'm checking the document for contradictions, and the shipping terms look off: it says EXW Boise, but also says the seller prepays freight, insurance and duties, which doesn't fit EXW. DDP isn't agreed, so I'll flag that. Quantity is 9,500, unit price 6.11 USD, with no total given and a confirmed date of 2026-07-16.

I'm mapping the dates to their fields: the 2026-07-16 confirmed date goes to date_confirmed, and the 2026-06-12 order date goes to date_ordered. For quantity, the confirmed figure goes to quantity_confirmed. There's no document date beyond the order date, so that one stays null.

verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26257769 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318676 (dated 2026-06-12). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,500 pcs at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-07-16. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The document has no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: the document says EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed', yet it also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so extra charges may appear on the invoice.
No total price or unit of measure is shown, and no document date is printed. Only the order date (2026-06-12) appears.
observations: Clean, typed single-page PDF with no stamps, signatures or handwriting.
The quantity has no unit of measure.
Description wraps over three lines in the table cell: 'Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5'.
